title: A Network Approach to Affect Regulation Dynamics and Personality Trait-Induced Variations: Extraversion and Neuroticism Moderate Reciprocal Influences between Affect and Affect Regulation Strategies
limitations: - Small sample size (n=78); - Limited number of affect regulation strategies examined due to methodological constraints of experience sampling; - Did not assess affectively salient events; - Did not include random slopes in models, potentially inflating Type I error rates; - No correction for multiple comparisons applied.
notes: The study used a network approach with multilevel vector autoregressive models to analyze affect regulation dynamics. The authors declared that the data and materials are openly accessible via OSF. The code used for analysis is also available on OSF. The study was preregistered on OSF. The authors did not report using a formal statistical test to compare centrality estimates between groups, although they did report on the moderation effects of extraversion and neuroticism on network connections.
